pack: Grade 1 Math: Unknown Numbers and True or False Equations Within 20

pages_detail.activities: Vector balance scales. Worked scale 5 and 5, level, Same shown. Practice scales 5 and 5, Same, and 4 and 6, Not Same. Child counts each side, writes Left and Right totals, circles Same or Not Same
pages_detail.title: Equal Means the Same Amount

pages_detail.activities: Worked example plus five practice equations. Large True and False pills on the right of each equation, vertically centred on the equation line
pages_detail.title: True or False?

pages_detail.activities: Worked example with a level balance scale showing a gold ? box plus 6 dots against 14 dots, plus four practice equations. Large answer boxes
pages_detail.title: Find the Missing Number in Addition

pages_detail.activities: Worked example with 16 dots, 5 crossed out, 11 left, plus eight practice equations in two columns. All three unknown positions: starting number, number subtracted, and difference
pages_detail.title: Find the Missing Number in Subtraction

pages_detail.activities: Scaffold faded, no worked example. Two true or false items, three missing-number items, and Fix the False One with a large new equation box
answers: Fix the False One: 8 + 3 = 12 is false; any fix changing exactly one number to a true equation: 8 + 3 = 11, 8 + 4 = 12, or 9 + 3 = 12
pages_detail.title: Mixed Check: True, False, or Missing?
